title: Versioned normalized session-event protocol

envelope.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline
envelope.evidence_digest_input: A bounded privacy-safe evidence projection, external to this protocol

ordering_and_correlation.sequence: Positive integers start at 1 and increase by exactly 1 per session trace
ordering_and_correlation.first: session_started at sequence 1 with correlation.parent_event_id null
ordering_and_correlation.parent: Every later event names the immediately preceding event as correlation.parent_event_id
ordering_and_correlation.session: All events in a trace use one session.id
ordering_and_correlation.terminal_rule: A terminal event is last; no event may follow it

binding.task_revision: Every event has the exact current Coordinator revision supplied to the checker
binding.worktree: Every event has the same session.worktree_key and worktree_digest
binding.session: session.id and correlation.session_id are constant for the trace
binding.adapter: adapter.id and adapter.version are constant for the trace

compatibility.minor: Additional protocol versions within major 1 require a separately documented compatible specification and checker update; this checker accepts only 1.0.0
compatibility.major: A new protocol id or major version is incompatible and must be rejected until explicitly supported

failure_semantics.side_effects: The checker performs no network, provider, process, Git, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, or UI operation

privacy.projection: Events contain identifiers, dispositions, and digests only; provider payloads and unbounded output are out of scope

invariants: A trace is valid only for one exact task revision, worktree binding, session, and adapter.
Event IDs, event digests, and evidence digests are single-use within a trace.
A terminal event fences the trace and cannot be followed.
Unknown or unsupported input is rejected rather than interpreted.
limitations: The checker proves the supplied trace is structurally consistent; it does not prove Coordinator state, evidence truth, implementation refinement, process isolation, or provider behavior.
A digest binds canonical bytes but does not authenticate the producer; signing and durable persistence remain external contracts.
This protocol does not define provider-specific policy, tool arguments, transcripts, or downstream execution behavior.
follow_up: Implement adapter and supervisor transitions against this boundary under separate ARs.
Integrate durable Coordinator revision and worktree observations through their authoritative contract.
